notes.title: Release Date be Upon Ye! Dicealot Coming Out October 9th!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hear ye, hear ye![/h2][p align="start"]
The announcement you have been waiting for is here! Following our grand reveal at the Convergence Games Showcase, we are thrilled to announce that [b]Dicealot[/b] shall be released upon the kingdom to all you eager and loyal dice rollers on [b]October 9th[/b]![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Mark thy calendars, for on this auspicious date, all strategists may finally test their mettle in the high-risk, high-rewards battle to save our beloved King Arthur![/p][p align="start"]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035330/Dicealot/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]🎬 New Trailer![/h3][p][/p][p align="start"]Our scribes have prepared moving images to commemorate this momentous occasion! Witness the grandeur of Dicealot as Queen Gwynevere and the King's faithful knights fight their way through a hoard of powerful enemies![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/auK3303QPRE?feature=shared"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The time draws near when your strategy and perseverance shall be tested, the path to your own victory forged and the kingdom restored.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][h1]Save The Kingdoms Quiz Competition! [/h1][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch date announcement, we're running a quiz competition! Half the questions are based on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035330/Dicealot/"]Dicealot[/url], and half the questions are about fellow medieval roguelike [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333700/The_Royal_Writ/"]The Royal Writ[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Every correct answer = 1 chance to win.[/b] That means you'll have a chance to win even if you're only familiar with [b]Dicealot[/b], but the odds are higher if you also know [b]The Royal Writ[/b]! All answers can be found in the demos. [/p][p][/p][h3]Take the quiz [url="https://forms.gle/juiMsSYnc4ne9chv7"]here[/url]! [/h3][p][b]PRIZE:[/b] 1x Steam key for [i]either[/i] [b]Dicealot[/b] [i]or[/i] [b]The Royal Writ[/b] (winner's choice!) [/p][p][b]DEADLINE:[/b] Thursday, 25 September 2025 16:00 BST[/p][p][i][url="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1eoonlX_MIWzQZP41RG5hF9RAXWMKFr5J/view?usp=sharing"]Terms & Conditions[/url] apply.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Be sure to [b]wishlist[/b] the game and join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/W4VzWHDF2U"]Discord[/url] legion to stay up to date with all things Dicealot. Fear not - our demo shall tide thee over until the glorious day![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280790/Dicealot_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]

notes.title: Demo Update - V0.5.15
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Questers!

Yesterday's update targeted a few big pieces of feedback from Nextfest as well as squashing the cause of a common crash

[b]New Features[/b]

- Auto-banking - Once you roll, double click on any dice to automatically send it to the bottom row and bank it. You can still drag if you prefer but this should speed up grinding through those hands in your 1s and 5s builds!

- Manual dice re-positioning on the board - Want to sort your dice on the board or remove those pesky overlaps? Click and drag the dice somewhere else on the game board.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

- Implented a fix for the crashing when banking a 6 dice combo. This hit quite a few people so please let us know if you still hit this crash after this update!

Also included are various balance and price changes for existing quest and power dice

As always, jump on our discord if you want to chat with us, make suggestions, or report any issues!

[url=Dicealot Discord]https://discord.gg/XTB2XB4PSp[/url]
